what: Live probe of Lifeline's reactive-chain rescue path on Reactive Lasna (5318007). Run 2026-11-23.
findings: BlacklistContract(address indexed) and WhitelistContract(address indexed) are emitted by the system contract 0x8888 on Lasna, topic1 = the contract, no data.
A reactive contract can subscribe to those system-contract events on its own chain and they ARE delivered to react().
SYSTEM.depositTo{value}(target) works when called from inside react().
A contract deployed with no balance is blacklisted on its first reaction (debt 0.0155348 lREACT for one Cron10 reaction).
Cron events on Lasna are still emitted from 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000fffFfF (Cron1 every block, Cron10 every 10 blocks).
Three contracts were blacklisted network-wide in the ~5000 blocks before the probe.
The rescue repeated (2 ReactiveRescued events) before the victim was stopped, bounded by the sponsor budget and the 30 s minGap.
notTested: The destination half (LifelineFunder on Base / Unichain) against the real callback proxy.
A rescued contract's missed events: nothing was replayed; only delivery going forward is restored.
